parsed.summary: Someone on the floor mentioned a possible shortage of something electronic sometime soon. The report was not confirmed by anyone. Part of the message was not actionable and was escalated to a human.
parsed.decision_reason: Acted on every confirmed incident: ids and dates resolved against the data, rehearsal on the digital twin passed with zero failures, the live schedule baseline matched before the first write. The unclear part was escalated without operational change (rule 8).
